final: WITH r AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB)*1.0/AVG(HCT) AS ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID HAVING AVG(HGB) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(HCT) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(HCT) <> 0), a1 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS m1 FROM r), k1 AS (SELECT r.ID, r.ratio, r.ratio - a1.m1 AS d1 FROM r, a1 WHERE r.ratio > a1.m1), a2 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS m2 FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.ratio, k1.d1, k1.ratio - a2.m2 AS d2 FROM k1, a2 WHERE k1.ratio > a2.m2) SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(d1) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(d2) AS avg_above_second FROM k2
